killedBy: capture.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute (issue #841) removes the AudioContext constructor for every state, not just the ones that ask
why: Leaves the AudioContext constructor in place for every capture. On a host whose audio service never connects the constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, and the app builds two during startup -- Howler's and `engine.ts`'s -- so the page blocks for ~40 s and every capture of a script-running state dies on Playwright's 30 s navigation default. That is issue #860's 'wedged browser': it looked like a broken local Chromium because the script-disabled states were the only ones that still came back.
